name: 会話ごとのメッセージ保存期間パネル
prompt: Recreate the full Japanese disappearing-messages settings screen on an exact 390 × 736 white canvas. Use image 1 as the authority for all Japanese text, layout, spacing, and selected state. Use image 2 to preserve the original disappearing-messages illustration exactly; exclude all English source copy and app chrome. Top header: 「消えるメッセージ」 at x=24,y=10, Meiryo Bold 20px/28px #1D1D1D; subtitle 「あなた・山田 はるか」 at x=24,y=52, Meiryo Regular 12px/16px #6E6E6E. Preserve the original illustration at x=108,y=84,size=174×126, including its pale-gray tile and exact shapes/colors. Below it, match the introductory section: title 「この会話のメッセージを自動で消去」 at x=30,y=232, Meiryo Bold 14px/24px #1D1D1D; four exact body lines at x=30,y=274, Meiryo Regular 12px/16px #6E6E6E: 「選んだ期間が過ぎると、この会話の新しい」 / 「メッセージは参加者全員の画面から消去されます。」 / 「保持されたメッセージは対象になりません。」 / 「参加者はこの設定を変更できます。」 Then show the actual hyperlink 「詳しく見る」 at x=30,y=350 in Meiryo Bold 12px/16px blue #2563EB. The native preview uses green for this link, but the user explicitly requires blue for actual hyperlinks. Color no other text blue and do not underline. Next, render heading 「メッセージの保存期間」 at x=30,y=410, 12px Regular gray. Use the pale mint #ECFDF5 panel at x=16,y=440,size=358×192 with the four exact dark 14px Regular options 「24時間」「7日間」「90日間」「自動消去しない」, preserving the selected green #047857 check beside 「自動消去しない」. At the bottom, preserve the informational/navigation row with green info icon, dark bold 「標準のメッセージ保存期間を設定」, gray subtitle 「新しい会話から適用されます」, and gray chevron; this is an action row, not a blue hyperlink. Keep everything compact and aligned with the native preview, with no extra cards, borders, shadows, or decorative elements.
reviewNotes: First pass preserves all Japanese copy, selected timer state, and the user-requested blue #2563EB hyperlink; the bottom action row stays dark. Illustration frame is about 12% oversized and roughly 5px low, shifting the intro heading/body about 14–16px low; link sits roughly 30px low due extra gap after the body. Timer heading/panel are 10–14px low and the panel extends about 10px too far down; bottom row is about 8px low. Requires second pass.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
